answer_1.quote: Data-to-text (D2T) generation is the task of transforming structured data into a natural language text which represents it.
answer_1.outputs: Natural language sentences that verbalize RDF triples

answer_2.quote: We compute the metrics used in the evaluation of the E2E Challenge : BLEU , NIST , METEOR , ROUGE L and CIDEr.

answer_3.quote: We use an additional component for calculating an indirect measure of the text fluency. We refer to the component as the LMSCORER. In our case, LM-SCORER is a pre-trained GPT-2 language model ... We use LMSCORER to compute the score of the input text ... Finally, we rescore the remaining hypotheses in the beam with LMSCORER and let the hypothesis with the best score be the base text.
methods: language model scoring (geometric mean of token conditional probabilities)
